style: modular-monolith-first, event-driven boundaries, extract services only by measured need
data: Postgres/Neon source of truth; append-only clinical events + normalized projections; transactional outbox
consistency: strong consistency inside clinical aggregate; explicit eventual consistency across async projections
security: tenant isolation + least privilege + purpose of use + immutable audit evidence
delivery: evidence-gated feature release with shadow/canary/enabled states
reliability: idempotency, optimistic concurrency, retry/dead-letter, reconciliation ownership
observability: capability-scoped clinical SLOs and rollback triggers
ai: gateway only; bounded tasks; safety envelopes; no direct irreversible clinical actions
principle: do not distribute complexity prematurely; preserve service extraction seams
